scientific_integrity: Full algebraic proof of all q, with finite-field verification only as corroboration. Smooth-q-bic general theory, rational Hermitian point count, and support identification are background rather than claimed novelties.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-p fields, prime powers q>=2, and the exact projective Hermitian cone in P^3. No general claim for all degenerate q-bic forms, no deformation classification. Priority beyond accessed primary sources and related finding records is not conclusively ruled out; independent external mathematical validation has not occurred.
title: Embedded rational generators in the Fano scheme of a Hermitian cone
